editorial:
Imagine trying to hold your life together while your world falls apart. You follow Norma, a single mom who is just trying to raise her son, Lenny, after her partner Henri vanished without a trace. The whole mood feels heavy and a bit weird because Norma keeps seeing Henri in her dreams. It is a stressful look at motherhood and grief, but things take a wild turn when she wakes up one day and realizes she is pregnant. You will find yourself wondering if she is actually going crazy or if something supernatural is happening between her dreams and her real life.

What really works here is the acting, as you can feel Norma's panic in every scene. The pacing starts slow but picks up speed as the mystery unfolds. While some parts might feel a bit too sad, the big reveal makes the wait worth it. If you love stories that mess with your head, you should definitely check this out. It looks amazing in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your shelf is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: The big twist is that Henri never actually left Norma. He exists in a dream world that she can visit while asleep. During those visits, they were still together, and that is how she became pregnant. In the final scene, Norma decides to stop fighting the two worlds. She accepts the baby as a bridge between her and Henri, finding peace with the fact that he is gone from the physical world but still with her.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological mysteries and emotional family stories.
